faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for WCDC Munger Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 16 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in WCDC Munger Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 5 vacancies: 2 Case Worker, 1 Psycho-Social Counselor, 1 Para Legal Person, 1 Para Medical Person.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for WCDC Munger Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: By email to [email protected], on or before 16 November 2026. There is no online form.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post - Case Worker: 21 to 40 years; Psycho-Social Counselor: 21 to 40 years; Para Legal Person: 21 to 40 years; Para Medical Person: 18 to 40 years. Relaxation: Unreserved Male 37, Backward Class / Extremely Backward Class (Male & Female) 40, Unreserved Female 40, Scheduled Caste / Scheduled Tribe (Male & Female) 42.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: 22,000 per month for Case Worker, 22,000 per month for Psycho-Social Counselor, 8,000 per month consolidated for Para Legal Person, 8,000 per month consolidated for Para Medical Person.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Graduation in Law/Social Work/Sociology/Social Science/Psychology/Neuro Science, or Diploma/Degree in Paramedics with required experience. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Applicants must be citizens of India. Bihar government reservation rules applicable. Benefit of reservation applicable only to Bihar domicile candidates.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Shortlisting based on required educational qualification and work experience. Interview. Preparation of final merit list. Interview intimation will be sent via email provided in the application and published on https://munger.nic.in website.

faq.question: Q9. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Purely temporary contract appointment. Can be terminated without prior notice or on one month notice. No claim for regular appointment will be entertained.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the posting for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Munger.
